strata.name: primary
strata.description: standard sampler, unbiased mix of layouts

strata.name: shortcut
strata.description: disclosed stratum: a wall slot near the straight cup-to-tray line (geometry only)

strata.name: blocked
strata.description: the wall spans the workspace; the slot is the only opening (trade-off stratum)

objective_of_record.source: model A on transport segments: rotation_penalty = b / a

spec_provenance.source: replay of recorded model responses on the pinned reference demonstration
spec_provenance.correction_text: This container must remain upright throughout transport, not just at the destination.

checker: mirror.evaluate.trial.execute_trial + mirror.evaluate.paired._record (corrected rules as extra rules)
hypotheses: H1: the original specification planned with the calibrated rotation price carries the cup on a tilted route on fewer layouts than at 0.05 (primary and shortcut strata).
H2: the corrected-minus-original gap in violation-free success is smaller with both conditions planned at the calibrated price than with both at 0.05.
H3: the never-tilt baseline completes no blocked layout, and on the primary and shortcut strata it is never faster on average than the corrected specification at the same price.

analysis_plan.unit: layout (seed); every condition on the identical scene; all seeds and attempts reported
analysis_plan.conditions_note: original@<cal>, original@0.05/0.10/0.20/0.40/1.0, never_tilt@<cal>, corrected@<cal>, corrected@0.05 (the last replicates the earlier registrations' setting on fresh layouts)
metrics: completion (all objects in the tray, settled)
violation-free success under the corrected rule (primary endpoint)
cup tilted on its planned route; corrected-rule violations; max cup tilt in transport
retained beads (total minus lost) and beads lost
path length (m), rotation (rad) and path cost at the calibrated price, from the executed plan
execution time (s, simulated) and planning failures (with proven infeasibility records)
comparisons: primary: corrected@cal vs original@cal, violation-free success, exact two-sided McNemar, Wilson 95% intervals, paired bootstrap 95% CI (10,000 resamples over seeds), per stratum
retained benefit = (VFS corrected@cal - VFS original@cal) / (VFS corrected@0.05 - VFS original@0.05), per stratum, with a seed-bootstrap 95% CI; undefined if the denominator is 0
sweep: every metric for original@lam at each lam, per stratum
time and cost: paired mean differences (bootstrap CI) of execution time and calibrated path cost, corrected@cal vs original@cal, never_tilt@cal vs corrected@cal, never_tilt@cal vs original@cal
trade-offs: layouts where a condition fails to plan or execute while another completes; blocked stratum completion and beads lost per condition
analysis_plan.decision_rules: none beyond reporting; no baseline is tuned; the calibrated price is fixed before freeze

seed_audit.result: no seed of this registration found

run_rules: run only from a clean checkout of the commit that adds this file
every attempt is kept in its own folder and reported
MIRROR_EVAL_LEDGER is set to this registration's ledger by the runner
